'''Rylee Lawson''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] [[Youngling|child]] who was the son of [[Captain]] [[Brander Lawson]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Watch the Official Trailer" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rylee Lawson is set to appear in the upcoming [[2026]] [[Disney+]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord]]''. The character will be voiced by [[Charlie Bushnell]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-maul-shadow-lord-first-trailer-poster-art|text=Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord Teaser Trailer and First Poster Arrive}}</ref>
